headline: Claude integration tools proliferate as developers build workflow bridges
body: Claude tooling ecosystem expanded this week with multiple integrations hitting developer platforms, including Juncts for unified messaging and Anthropic's Claude Ship for autonomous code review. For healthcare AI, this matters because fragmented workflows between clinical documentation, EHR systems, and communication apps create friction that slows decision-making. As Claude capabilities embed deeper into development and operations tooling, healthcare vendors face pressure to integrate these models into their existing stacks for clinical efficiency. The velocity of third-party Claude integrations suggests the vendor landscape will rapidly consolidate around platforms that streamline multi-system workflows rather than point solutions.
